patch.value: A configuration-only settings scope does not expire for work captured inside it, so a deferred SDK read keeps seeing no file-backed schema fields

Found by review of the host-client preview path. PmClient.previewItemMutations and itemTransactions.status run their extension activation inside runWithConfigurationOnlySettings. A callback captured during that activation and run after the preview settled still carries the configuration-only policy in its async context, so a later same-tracker read such as schemaListFields returns no file-backed fields. The ordinary client path has had this shape since previews were introduced; the host-client path gained it when host transactions started to activate their own tracker. The extension scope already expires on settle (live flag); the settings policy layer has no equivalent.

runWithConfigurationOnlySettings marks its layer expired when its callback settles and readers skip an expired layer; A spec captures a read inside a preview's activation, runs it after the preview settles, and sees file-backed schema fields
A settings policy layer ends when the call that opened it settles; deferred work reads ordinary settings
Deferred work captured inside a preview keeps configuration-only settings indefinitely
